en: Writing and scheduling blog posts for SEO

Managing tracking tags without editing site code

Website files host aur backup karna

exp.mr: KPI = Key Performance Indicator: मुख्य business ध्येय किती साध्य होत आहे हे दाखवणारे मोजता येणारे मूल्य, उदा. दरमहा leads किंवा cost per sale.

q.en: A landing page gets 2,000 visitors and 60 of them buy. What is its conversion rate?
q.hi: Ek landing page pe 2,000 visitors aaye aur 60 ne kharida. Conversion rate kitna hai?
q.mr: एका landing page वर 2,000 visitors आले आणि 60 जणांनी खरेदी केली. Conversion rate किती?

exp.en: Conversion rate = conversions ÷ visitors × 100 = 60 ÷ 2,000 × 100 = 3%.
exp.hi: Conversion rate = conversions ÷ visitors × 100 = 60 ÷ 2,000 × 100 = 3%.
exp.mr: Conversion rate = conversions ÷ visitors × 100 = 60 ÷ 2,000 × 100 = 3%.

q.en: What is an A/B test?
q.hi: A/B test kya hota hai?
q.mr: A/B test म्हणजे काय?

en: Checking how a website looks on two browsers
Running the same ad on two platforms at once
Collecting feedback from two groups of customers
Randomly splitting users between two versions
hi: Website do browsers pe kaisi dikhti hai check karna
Same ad do platforms pe ek saath chalana
Customers ke do groups se feedback lena
Users ko randomly do versions mein baant ke compare karna
mr: वेबसाइट दोन browsers वर कशी दिसते ते तपासणे
एकच ad दोन platforms वर एकाच वेळी चालवणे
ग्राहकांच्या दोन गटांकडून feedback घेणे
Users ना randomly दोन versions मध्ये विभागून तुलना करणे

exp.en: In an A/B test, traffic is randomly split between version A (control) and version B (variant), and a chosen metric like conversion rate is compared.
exp.hi: A/B test mein traffic randomly version A (control) aur version B (variant) mein split hota hai, aur conversion rate jaisa metric compare kiya jaata hai.
exp.mr: A/B test मध्ये traffic randomly version A (control) आणि version B (variant) मध्ये विभागला जातो आणि conversion rate सारखा metric तुलना केला जातो.

q.en: Which of these is usually a 'vanity metric' for an online store?
q.hi: Online store ke liye inmein se usually 'vanity metric' kaunsa hai?

Revenue per visitor

Repeat purchase rate
hi: Instagram follower count
Revenue per visitor
Customer acquisition cost
Repeat purchase rate
mr: Instagram follower count
Revenue per visitor
Customer acquisition cost
Repeat purchase rate

exp.en: Vanity metrics look impressive but don't directly show business results. Followers can grow while sales stay flat; revenue per visitor, CAC and repeat rate tie to money.
exp.hi: Vanity metrics dikhne mein impressive hote hain par business result nahi batate. Followers badh sakte hain aur sales flat reh sakti hai; revenue per visitor, CAC, repeat rate seedha paise se jude hain.
exp.mr: Vanity metrics दिसायला छान असतात पण business result थेट दाखवत नाहीत. Followers वाढले तरी sales स्थिर राहू शकतात; revenue per visitor, CAC आणि repeat rate थेट पैशाशी जोडलेले आहेत.

q.hi: Web tracking mein 'cookie' kya hota hai?

en: A virus that steals saved passwords
A paid ad format shown on Google
A small text file a site stores in your browser
A pop-up that asks for your email address

Google pe dikhne wala paid ad format

Email address maangne wala pop-up

Site तुमच्या browser मध्ये ठेवणारी छोटी text file

exp.hi: Cookie ek chhoti text file hai jo browser mein save hoti hai. Sites isse login, cart yaad rakhti hain aur analytics mein returning browser ko pehchanti hain.
exp.mr: Cookie ही browser मध्ये save होणारी छोटी text file आहे. Sites याने login, cart लक्षात ठेवतात आणि analytics मध्ये परत आलेला browser ओळखतात.

q.en: What is a 'first-party' cookie?
q.hi: 'First-party' cookie kya hoti hai?
q.mr: 'First-party' cookie म्हणजे काय?

en: A cookie that stores your login password
A cookie sold to other companies for ads
A cookie that always expires after 1 day
A cookie set by the site you are visiting

Ads ke liye doosri companies ko bechi gayi cookie
Hamesha 1 din baad expire hone wali cookie
Jo site aap visit kar rahe ho, usi ki set ki cookie

तुम्ही उघडलेल्या site ने set केलेली cookie

exp.en: First-party cookies are set by the site in the address bar; third-party cookies are set by other domains (like ad networks) embedded on the page.
exp.hi: First-party cookies wahi site set karti hai jo address bar mein hai; third-party cookies page pe embedded doosre domains (jaise ad networks) set karte hain.
exp.mr: First-party cookies address bar मधील site set करते; third-party cookies page वर embed केलेले इतर domains (उदा. ad networks) set करतात.

q.en: In analytics, what is a 'funnel'?
q.hi: Analytics mein 'funnel' kya hota hai?
q.mr: Analytics मध्ये 'funnel' म्हणजे काय?

en: The steps users take to a goal, showing drop-offs
A ranked list of your top search keywords
A chart of daily ad spend by campaign
A group of users who live in one city
hi: Goal tak ke steps, jisme drop-offs dikhte hain
Aapke top search keywords ki ranked list
Campaign-wise daily ad spend ka chart
Ek hi sheher mein rehne wale users ka group
mr: Goal पर्यंतचे steps, ज्यात drop-offs दिसतात
तुमच्या top search keywords ची क्रमवार यादी
Campaign नुसार रोजच्या ad spend चा chart
एकाच शहरात राहणाऱ्या users चा गट

exp.en: A funnel (e.g. product view → add to cart → checkout → purchase) shows how many users move through each step, so you can fix the biggest drop-off.
exp.hi: Funnel (jaise product view → add to cart → checkout → purchase) dikhata hai har step pe kitne users aage badhe, taaki sabse bade drop-off ko fix kar sako.
exp.mr: Funnel (उदा. product view → add to cart → checkout → purchase) प्रत्येक step वर किती users पुढे गेले ते दाखवतो, म्हणजे सर्वात मोठा drop-off दुरुस्त करता येतो.

q.en: In Google Tag Manager, what does a 'trigger' do?

q.mr: Google Tag Manager मध्ये 'trigger' काय करतो?

en: Stores a value like the page URL
Publishes the container to the live site
Decides WHEN a tag should fire
Creates a new GA4 property
hi: Page URL jaisi value store karta hai
Container ko live site pe publish karta hai
Decide karta hai tag KAB fire hoga
Naya GA4 property banata hai
mr: Page URL सारखी value साठवतो
Container live site वर publish करतो

नवीन GA4 property तयार करतो

exp.hi: Tag matlab kya fire hoga (jaise GA4 event), trigger matlab kab (jaise Buy button pe click), aur variables values rakhte hain (jaise Page URL, Click Text).
exp.mr: Tag म्हणजे काय fire होणार (उदा. GA4 event), trigger म्हणजे केव्हा (उदा. Buy button वर click), आणि variables values साठवतात (उदा. Page URL, Click Text).

q.hi: GTM mein 'variable' kis kaam aata hai?
q.mr: GTM मध्ये 'variable' कशासाठी वापरतात?

To hold a value like Page URL for tags/triggers
To store customer passwords securely
To choose the GA4 reporting time zone

Tags/triggers ke liye Page URL jaisi value rakhna
Customer passwords secure store karna
GA4 reporting time zone chunna

Path मधील सर्व touchpoints मध्ये समान
100% पहिल्या click ला
Sale च्या जवळच्या touchpoints ना जास्त

exp.en: Linear splits credit equally (4 touchpoints = 25% each). 'More credit closer to the sale' is time decay. Note: GA4 dropped linear and time decay models in 2023.
exp.hi: Linear credit barabar baantta hai (4 touchpoints = 25% each). 'Sale ke paas wale ko zyada' time decay hai. Note: GA4 ne 2023 mein linear aur time decay models hata diye.
exp.mr: Linear credit समान वाटतो (4 touchpoints = प्रत्येकी 25%). 'Sale जवळच्यांना जास्त' म्हणजे time decay. टीप: GA4 ने 2023 मध्ये linear आणि time decay models काढून टाकले.

q.en: What do heatmap tools (like Microsoft Clarity or Hotjar) mainly show?
q.hi: Heatmap tools (jaise Microsoft Clarity ya Hotjar) mainly kya dikhate hain?
q.mr: Heatmap tools (उदा. Microsoft Clarity किंवा Hotjar) मुख्यतः काय दाखवतात?

en: Your Google search rankings over time
Competitors' monthly ad budgets
Email open and click rates
Where users click and how far they scroll
hi: Time ke saath aapki Google search rankings
Competitors ke monthly ad budgets
Email open aur click rates
Users kahan click karte hain aur kitna scroll
mr: वेळेनुसार तुमचे Google search rankings
Competitors चे मासिक ad budgets
Email open आणि click rates
Users कुठे click करतात आणि किती scroll करतात

exp.en: Heatmaps and session recordings give qualitative CRO insight: e.g. users clicking a non-clickable image, or never scrolling to the 'Book Now' button.
exp.hi: Heatmaps aur session recordings CRO ke liye qualitative insight dete hain: jaise users non-clickable image pe click kar rahe hain, ya 'Book Now' button tak scroll hi nahi karte.
exp.mr: Heatmaps आणि session recordings CRO साठी qualitative माहिती देतात: उदा. users non-clickable image वर click करतात, किंवा 'Book Now' button पर्यंत scroll करतच नाहीत.

q.en: Which of these is a 'micro-conversion' for an online coaching institute whose main goal is paid enrolments?
q.hi: Online coaching institute ka main goal paid enrolment hai. Inmein se 'micro-conversion' kaunsa hai?
q.mr: Online coaching institute चे मुख्य ध्येय paid enrolments आहे. यापैकी 'micro-conversion' कोणते?

en: Downloading the free syllabus PDF
A paid enrolment in a full course
A renewal payment for next term
The annual fee paid by a student
hi: Free syllabus PDF download karna
Full course mein paid enrolment
Agle term ka renewal payment
Student ki annual fee payment
mr: मोफत syllabus PDF download करणे
पूर्ण course मध्ये paid enrolment
पुढील term चे renewal payment
विद्यार्थ्याचे वार्षिक fee payment

exp.en: Micro-conversions are smaller steps that signal intent (PDF download, demo-class sign-up). The payments are macro-conversions — the main business outcome.
exp.hi: Micro-conversions chhote steps hain jo intent dikhate hain (PDF download, demo class sign-up). Payments macro-conversions hain — main business outcome.
exp.mr: Micro-conversions हे intent दाखवणारे छोटे steps आहेत (PDF download, demo class sign-up). Payments हे macro-conversions — मुख्य business परिणाम.

q.en: What is a 'cohort' in cohort analysis?
q.hi: Cohort analysis mein 'cohort' kya hota hai?
q.mr: Cohort analysis मध्ये 'cohort' म्हणजे काय?

en: All users who arrived from one traffic source
The top 10% of customers ranked by revenue
Users who began in the same period, e.g. January
A random sample of users used in an A/B test
hi: Ek traffic source se aaye saare users
Revenue ke hisaab se top 10% customers
Same period mein shuru karne wale users, jaise January
A/B test mein use hua users ka random sample
mr: एका traffic source मधून आलेले सर्व users
Revenue नुसार top 10% ग्राहक
एकाच कालावधीत सुरुवात केलेले users, उदा. January
A/B test मध्ये वापरलेला users चा random sample

exp.en: A cohort groups users by when they started (sign-up week, first order month). Tracking each cohort over time shows whether retention is improving.
exp.hi: Cohort users ko unke start time se group karta hai (sign-up week, first order month). Har cohort ko time ke saath track karne se pata chalta hai retention improve ho raha hai ya nahi.
exp.mr: Cohort users ना त्यांनी केव्हा सुरुवात केली त्यानुसार गटबद्ध करतो (sign-up आठवडा, पहिल्या order चा महिना). प्रत्येक cohort वेळेनुसार पाहिल्यास retention सुधारते आहे का ते कळते.

q.en: By default, which session counts as 'engaged' in GA4?
q.hi: Default mein GA4 mein kaunsa session 'engaged' mana jaata hai?
q.mr: Default नुसार GA4 मध्ये कोणते session 'engaged' मानले जाते?

en: Any session with at least one click on the page
Any session that comes from a returning user
Any session that lasts longer than 60 seconds
10+ seconds, or a key event, or 2+ page views
hi: Page pe kam se kam ek click wala koi bhi session
Returning user se aane wala koi bhi session
60 seconds se lamba chalne wala koi bhi session
10+ seconds, ya key event, ya 2+ page views
mr: Page वर किमान एक click असलेले कोणतेही session
Returning user कडून येणारे कोणतेही session
60 seconds पेक्षा जास्त चालणारे कोणतेही session
10+ seconds, किंवा key event, किंवा 2+ page views

exp.en: GA4 marks a session engaged if it lasts over 10 seconds (adjustable), fires a key event, or has 2+ page/screen views. Engagement rate = engaged sessions ÷ sessions.
exp.hi: GA4 session ko engaged maanta hai agar woh 10 seconds se zyada chale (adjustable), key event ho, ya 2+ page/screen views hon. Engagement rate = engaged sessions ÷ sessions.
exp.mr: GA4 session engaged मानतो जर ते 10 seconds पेक्षा जास्त चालले (बदलता येते), key event झाला, किंवा 2+ page/screen views झाले. Engagement rate = engaged sessions ÷ sessions.

q.en: What is GA4's default session timeout (inactivity before a session ends)?
q.hi: GA4 ka default session timeout (kitni inactivity ke baad session khatam) kya hai?
q.mr: GA4 चा default session timeout (किती निष्क्रियतेनंतर session संपते) किती आहे?

en: 30 minutes
10 minutes
2 hours
24 hours
hi: 30 minutes
10 minutes
2 hours
24 hours
mr: 30 minutes
10 minutes
2 hours
24 hours

exp.en: A GA4 session ends after 30 minutes of inactivity by default; you can adjust it in the data stream's tag settings (up to 7 hours 55 minutes).
exp.hi: GA4 session default mein 30 minute inactivity ke baad khatam hota hai; ise data stream ki tag settings mein badal sakte ho (7 ghante 55 minute tak).
exp.mr: GA4 session default नुसार 30 मिनिटांच्या निष्क्रियतेनंतर संपते; data stream च्या tag settings मध्ये ते बदलता येते (7 तास 55 मिनिटांपर्यंत).

q.en: A Pune bakery sends festive offers on WhatsApp with a website link. In GA4, these visits mostly show up as 'Direct'. What should they do?
q.hi: Pune ki ek bakery WhatsApp pe festive offers website link ke saath bhejti hai. GA4 mein ye visits mostly 'Direct' dikhte hain. Kya karein?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एक bakery WhatsApp वर festive offers website link सह पाठवते. GA4 मध्ये या visits बहुतेक 'Direct' दिसतात. काय करावे?

en: Stop using WhatsApp, since it can't be tracked
Add UTM tags, e.g. utm_source=whatsapp
Turn on Google Signals to reveal the source
Create a separate GA4 property for WhatsApp
hi: WhatsApp band karo, kyunki track nahi hota
UTM tags lagao, jaise utm_source=whatsapp
Source dekhne ke liye Google Signals on karo
WhatsApp ke liye alag GA4 property banao
mr: WhatsApp बंद करा, कारण track होत नाही
UTM tags लावा, उदा. utm_source=whatsapp
Source दिसण्यासाठी Google Signals चालू करा
WhatsApp साठी वेगळी GA4 property तयार करा

exp.en: Messaging apps often pass no referrer, so clicks look like Direct. UTM tags explicitly label source/medium/campaign so the traffic is attributed correctly.
exp.hi: Messaging apps aksar referrer pass nahi karte, isliye clicks Direct lagte hain. UTM tags source/medium/campaign ko clearly label karte hain taaki traffic sahi attribute ho.
exp.mr: Messaging apps बहुतेक वेळा referrer पाठवत नाहीत, त्यामुळे clicks Direct दिसतात. UTM tags source/medium/campaign स्पष्ट लिहितात म्हणून traffic योग्य attribute होतो.

q.en: A coaching institute's enquiry form redirects to /thank-you after submit. They use GTM and GA4. Simplest way to track enquiries?
q.hi: Ek coaching institute ka enquiry form submit ke baad /thank-you pe redirect karta hai. GTM aur GA4 use hota hai. Enquiries track karne ka simplest tareeka?
q.mr: एका coaching institute चा enquiry form submit नंतर /thank-you वर जातो. GTM आणि GA4 वापरतात. Enquiries track करण्याचा सोपा मार्ग?

en: Count the home page's total daily pageviews
Ask each student to email a screenshot
Fire a GA4 key event on /thank-you page views
Add a UTM tag to the thank-you page URL
hi: Home page ke daily total pageviews gino
Har student se screenshot email karwao
/thank-you page view pe GA4 key event fire karo
Thank-you page URL pe UTM tag lagao
mr: Home page चे रोजचे एकूण pageviews मोजा
प्रत्येक student कडून screenshot email मागवा
/thank-you page view वर GA4 key event fire करा
Thank-you page URL ला UTM tag लावा

exp.en: A thank-you page is only reached after a successful submit, so a page-view trigger on it is a simple, reliable lead event. UTMs on internal URLs would overwrite the real traffic source.
exp.hi: Thank-you page sirf successful submit ke baad aata hai, isliye uspe page-view trigger simple aur reliable lead event hai. Internal URL pe UTM lagane se asli traffic source overwrite ho jaata hai.
exp.mr: Thank-you page फक्त यशस्वी submit नंतरच येते, म्हणून त्यावरचा page-view trigger हा सोपा व विश्वसनीय lead event आहे. Internal URL वर UTM लावल्यास खरा traffic source overwrite होतो.

q.en: A D2C snacks brand proudly reports '+50,000 Instagram followers this quarter', but online sales are flat. Which KPI should lead the next report?
q.hi: Ek D2C snacks brand report karta hai '+50,000 Instagram followers is quarter', par online sales flat hai. Agli report mein kaunsa KPI lead karna chahiye?
q.mr: एक D2C snacks brand '+50,000 Instagram followers या quarter' असे सांगतो, पण online sales स्थिर आहेत. पुढच्या report मध्ये कोणता KPI आघाडीवर हवा?

en: Revenue and CPA from Instagram-driven orders
Total likes and comments across all posts
Average views and shares per Reel
Number of posts published every week
hi: Instagram se aaye orders ka revenue aur CPA
Saare posts ke total likes aur comments
Har Reel ke average views aur shares
Har hafte publish hue posts ki ginti
mr: Instagram मधून आलेल्या orders चे revenue आणि CPA
सर्व posts वरील एकूण likes आणि comments
प्रत्येक Reel चे सरासरी views आणि shares
दर आठवड्याला publish झालेल्या posts ची संख्या

exp.en: Followers, likes and views are vanity metrics here. The business goal is sales, so report revenue and CPA from Instagram (tracked with UTMs/pixel) to judge the channel.
exp.hi: Yahan followers, likes, views vanity metrics hain. Business goal sales hai, isliye Instagram se revenue aur CPA (UTM/pixel se track karke) report karo.
exp.mr: इथे followers, likes, views हे vanity metrics आहेत. Business ध्येय sales आहे, म्हणून Instagram मधून आलेले revenue आणि CPA (UTM/pixel ने track करून) report करा.

q.en: You added a GA4 'Book Now' click tag in GTM, but no events appear in GA4. What is the best first step?
q.hi: GTM mein GA4 'Book Now' click tag add kiya, par GA4 mein koi event nahi dikh raha. Sabse pehla best step kya hai?
q.mr: GTM मध्ये GA4 'Book Now' click tag जोडला, पण GA4 मध्ये event दिसत नाही. सर्वात आधी काय करावे?

en: Delete the GA4 property and set it up again
Wait 30 days for the data to start appearing
Switch to a different analytics tool entirely
Use GTM Preview mode to see if the trigger fires
hi: GA4 property delete karke dobara setup karo
Data dikhne ke liye 30 din wait karo
Poori tarah doosra analytics tool use karo
GTM Preview mode se dekho trigger fire hota hai ya nahi
mr: GA4 property delete करून पुन्हा setup करा
Data दिसण्यासाठी 30 दिवस थांबा
पूर्णपणे दुसरे analytics tool वापरा
GTM Preview mode ने trigger fire होतो का ते पाहा

exp.en: Preview mode shows which tags fired on each click and why triggers did or didn't match. Common culprits: container not published, or wrong trigger condition. GA4 DebugView helps too.
exp.hi: Preview mode dikhata hai har click pe kaunse tags fire hue aur trigger kyun match hua ya nahi. Common galti: container publish nahi hua, ya trigger condition galat hai. GA4 DebugView bhi madad karta hai.
exp.mr: Preview mode प्रत्येक click वर कोणते tags fire झाले आणि trigger का जुळला/नाही ते दाखवतो. नेहमीच्या चुका: container publish न होणे किंवा चुकीची trigger condition. GA4 DebugView ही उपयोगी आहे.

q.en: Your GA4 traffic report shows 'Facebook', 'facebook' and 'FB' as three separate sources for the same campaign. What's the fix?
q.hi: GA4 report mein ek hi campaign ke liye 'Facebook', 'facebook' aur 'FB' teen alag sources dikh rahe hain. Fix kya hai?
q.mr: GA4 report मध्ये एकाच campaign साठी 'Facebook', 'facebook' आणि 'FB' असे तीन वेगळे sources दिसतात. उपाय काय?

en: Nothing; GA4 merges them after 30 days
Remove UTMs from all Facebook ads
Enforce one lowercase UTM naming convention
Track Facebook only through the Meta Pixel
hi: Kuch nahi; GA4 30 din baad merge kar deta hai
Saare Facebook ads se UTMs hata do
Ek lowercase UTM naming convention lagu karo
Facebook sirf Meta Pixel se track karo
mr: काही नाही; GA4 30 दिवसांनी merge करते
सर्व Facebook ads मधून UTMs काढा
एक lowercase UTM naming convention लागू करा
Facebook फक्त Meta Pixel ने track करा

exp.en: UTM values are case-sensitive and taken literally, so variations split your data. A documented lowercase convention and a shared builder sheet keep reports clean.
exp.hi: UTM values case-sensitive hoti hain aur jaise likhi hain waise hi aati hain, isliye variations data baant dete hain. Documented lowercase convention aur shared builder sheet se reports saaf rehti hain.
exp.mr: UTM values case-sensitive असतात आणि जशी लिहिली तशीच येतात, त्यामुळे वेगवेगळी रूपे data विभागतात. लिखित lowercase convention आणि shared builder sheet ने reports स्वच्छ राहतात.

q.en: In GA4, what are 'Explorations' best used for, compared with standard Reports?
q.hi: GA4 mein standard Reports ke comparison mein 'Explorations' kis kaam ke liye best hain?
q.mr: GA4 मध्ये standard Reports च्या तुलनेत 'Explorations' कशासाठी सर्वोत्तम आहेत?

en: Sending scheduled reports by email automatically
Ad-hoc deep dives like custom funnels and paths
Editing past data that was collected wrongly
Setting the property's currency and time zone
hi: Scheduled reports automatically email karna
Custom funnels aur paths jaise ad-hoc deep dives
Galat collect hua purana data edit karna
Property ki currency aur time zone set karna
mr: Scheduled reports आपोआप email करणे
Custom funnels आणि paths सारखे ad-hoc सखोल analysis
चुकीचा गोळा झालेला जुना data edit करणे
Property ची currency आणि time zone ठरवणे

exp.en: Standard Reports are pre-built summaries; Explorations are a flexible workspace for funnels, paths, segment overlap and cohorts. Neither can edit already-processed data.
exp.hi: Standard Reports pre-built summaries hain; Explorations funnels, paths, segment overlap aur cohorts ke liye flexible workspace hai. Dono mein se koi bhi processed data edit nahi kar sakta.
exp.mr: Standard Reports हे तयार summaries आहेत; Explorations हे funnels, paths, segment overlap आणि cohorts साठी लवचिक workspace आहे. दोन्हीपैकी कोणीही processed data बदलू शकत नाही.

q.en: For a standard (free) GA4 property, what is the default event-data retention used by Explorations?
q.hi: Standard (free) GA4 property mein Explorations ke liye default event-data retention kitna hai?
q.mr: Standard (मोफत) GA4 property मध्ये Explorations साठी default event-data retention किती असते?

en: 2 months, which you can extend to 14 months
14 months, which you can extend to 50 months
Forever, with no limit
7 days, which you can extend to 30 days
hi: 2 months, jise 14 months tak badha sakte ho
14 months, jise 50 months tak badha sakte ho
Hamesha ke liye, koi limit nahi
7 din, jise 30 din tak badha sakte ho
mr: 2 महिने, जे 14 महिन्यांपर्यंत वाढवता येते
14 महिने, जे 50 महिन्यांपर्यंत वाढवता येते
कायमचे, कोणतीही मर्यादा नाही
7 दिवस, जे 30 दिवसांपर्यंत वाढवता येते

exp.en: Standard GA4 properties default to 2 months of event-level retention (max 14). It limits Explorations, not standard aggregated reports — so set it to 14 months on day one.
exp.hi: Standard GA4 properties ka default event-level retention 2 months hai (max 14). Ye Explorations ko limit karta hai, standard aggregated reports ko nahi — isliye pehle din hi 14 months set karo.
exp.mr: Standard GA4 properties चे default event-level retention 2 महिने आहे (कमाल 14). याचा परिणाम Explorations वर होतो, standard aggregated reports वर नाही — म्हणून पहिल्याच दिवशी 14 महिने करा.

q.en: Your brand site (brand.in) sends users to a booking site you own (bookbrand.com). In GA4, bookings show brand.in as a 'referral' and sessions break. Best fix?
q.hi: Aapki brand site (brand.in) users ko aapki hi booking site (bookbrand.com) pe bhejti hai. GA4 mein bookings ka source brand.in 'referral' dikhta hai aur sessions toot jaate hain. Best fix?
q.mr: तुमची brand site (brand.in) users ना तुमच्याच booking site (bookbrand.com) वर पाठवते. GA4 मध्ये bookings चा source brand.in 'referral' दिसतो आणि sessions तुटतात. योग्य उपाय?

en: Create two separate GA4 properties
Add UTM tags to every link between the sites
Turn off enhanced measurement on both sites
Set up cross-domain measurement for both domains
hi: Do alag GA4 properties banao
Dono sites ke beech har link pe UTM tags lagao
Dono sites pe enhanced measurement off karo
Dono domains ke liye cross-domain measurement set karo
mr: दोन वेगळ्या GA4 properties तयार करा
दोन्ही sites मधील प्रत्येक link ला UTM tags लावा
दोन्ही sites वर enhanced measurement बंद करा
दोन्ही domains साठी cross-domain measurement set करा

exp.en: Cross-domain measurement passes the user/session identifier via a _gl link parameter so both sites count as one journey. UTMs on internal links would overwrite the original source.
exp.hi: Cross-domain measurement _gl link parameter se user/session identifier pass karta hai taaki dono sites ek hi journey gine jaayein. Internal links pe UTM original source overwrite kar dete.
exp.mr: Cross-domain measurement _gl link parameter ने user/session identifier पाठवते, त्यामुळे दोन्ही sites एकच journey म्हणून मोजल्या जातात. Internal links वर UTM लावल्यास मूळ source overwrite होतो.

q.en: A D2C brand sees its payment gateway's domain as the top 'referral' source for purchases in GA4. What should they do?
q.hi: Ek D2C brand ko GA4 mein purchases ka top 'referral' source apne payment gateway ka domain dikhta hai. Kya karein?
q.mr: एका D2C brand ला GA4 मध्ये purchases चा top 'referral' source स्वतःच्या payment gateway चा domain दिसतो. काय करावे?

en: Stop the payment gateway from redirecting back
Add the gateway to GA4's unwanted referrals list
Delete the purchase event and recreate it
Tag the gateway's return URL with utm_source=gateway
hi: Payment gateway ko wapas redirect karne se roko
Gateway ko GA4 ki unwanted referrals list mein daalo
Purchase event delete karke dobara banao
Gateway ke return URL pe utm_source=gateway lagao
mr: Payment gateway ला परत redirect करण्यापासून थांबवा
Gateway ला GA4 च्या unwanted referrals यादीत टाका
Purchase event delete करून पुन्हा तयार करा
Gateway च्या return URL ला utm_source=gateway लावा

exp.en: When users return from a third-party gateway, GA4 treats it as a new referral and steals credit from the real channel. Listing it as an unwanted referral keeps the original source.
exp.hi: Jab user third-party gateway se wapas aata hai, GA4 use naya referral maan leta hai aur asli channel ka credit chheen leta hai. Unwanted referral mein daalne se original source bana rehta hai.
exp.mr: User third-party gateway वरून परत आल्यावर GA4 त्याला नवीन referral मानते आणि खऱ्या channel चे credit घेते. Unwanted referral मध्ये टाकल्यास मूळ source कायम राहतो.

q.en: What is a key benefit of linking GA4 to BigQuery?
q.hi: GA4 ko BigQuery se link karne ka ek main fayda kya hai?
q.mr: GA4 ला BigQuery शी link करण्याचा मुख्य फायदा काय?

en: It removes the need for a cookie consent banner
It makes every GA4 report load much faster
Raw event-level data you can query with SQL and join to CRM
It automatically improves your Google Ads Quality Score
hi: Cookie consent banner ki zaroorat khatam ho jaati hai
Har GA4 report bahut fast load hone lagti hai
Raw event-level data jise SQL se query aur CRM se join kar sako
Google Ads Quality Score automatically improve hota hai
mr: Cookie consent banner ची गरज संपते
प्रत्येक GA4 report खूप जलद load होतो
Raw event-level data जो SQL ने query करून CRM शी join करता येतो
Google Ads Quality Score आपोआप सुधारतो

exp.en: The BigQuery export gives unsampled, hit-level event data that you own, beyond GA4's UI retention limits, ideal for custom attribution, LTV and joining with offline/CRM data.
exp.hi: BigQuery export unsampled, event-level data deta hai jo aapka apna hai, GA4 UI ki retention limit se aage bhi — custom attribution, LTV aur offline/CRM data join ke liye ideal.
exp.mr: BigQuery export unsampled, event-level data देते जो तुमच्या मालकीचा असतो आणि GA4 UI च्या retention मर्यादेपलीकडेही राहतो — custom attribution, LTV आणि offline/CRM data join साठी उत्तम.

q.en: In A/B test planning, which change increases the sample size you need?
q.hi: A/B test planning mein kaunsa change zaroori sample size badhata hai?
q.mr: A/B test planning मध्ये कोणता बदल लागणारा sample size वाढवतो?

en: Wanting to detect a smaller minimum lift (MDE)
Accepting a lower confidence level, like 90%
Testing a much bolder design change
Having a higher baseline conversion rate
hi: Chhota minimum lift (MDE) detect karna chahna
Kam confidence level accept karna, jaise 90%
Kaafi zyada bold design change test karna
Baseline conversion rate zyada hona
mr: लहान minimum lift (MDE) ओळखायचा असणे
कमी confidence level स्वीकारणे, उदा. 90%
खूप ठळक design बदल test करणे
Baseline conversion rate जास्त असणे

exp.en: Detecting small effects needs many more visitors — roughly, halving the detectable lift needs about 4x the sample. Bolder changes and lower confidence need fewer.
exp.hi: Chhote effects detect karne ke liye bahut zyada visitors chahiye — roughly, detectable lift aadha karo to lagbhag 4x sample chahiye. Bold changes aur kam confidence mein kam chahiye.
exp.mr: लहान परिणाम ओळखायला खूप जास्त visitors लागतात — ढोबळमानाने detectable lift अर्धा केल्यास सुमारे 4 पट sample लागतो. ठळक बदल आणि कमी confidence ला कमी लागतो.

q.en: A Nashik dental clinic's landing page: 70% of traffic is mobile, but mobile converts at 0.5% vs 3% on desktop. Best next step?
q.hi: Nashik ke ek dental clinic ka landing page: 70% traffic mobile se, par mobile conversion 0.5% vs desktop 3%. Best next step?
q.mr: नाशिकच्या एका dental clinic चे landing page: 70% traffic mobile वरून, पण mobile conversion 0.5% तर desktop 3%. पुढचे योग्य पाऊल?

en: Stop all mobile ads from running immediately
Raise the mobile ad budget for more volume
Audit mobile speed, form length and tap-to-call
Redesign the desktop page before anything else
hi: Saare mobile ads turant band karo
Zyada volume ke liye mobile budget badhao
Mobile speed, form length aur tap-to-call audit karo
Sabse pehle desktop page redesign karo
mr: सर्व mobile ads लगेच बंद करा
जास्त volume साठी mobile budget वाढवा
Mobile speed, form ची लांबी आणि tap-to-call तपासा
सर्वात आधी desktop page redesign करा

exp.en: The segment gap points to a mobile UX problem on the page most visitors see. Fixing it (fast load, short form, click-to-call) usually beats cutting or scaling traffic blindly.
exp.hi: Segment gap batata hai ki mobile UX mein problem hai, jo zyada visitors dekhte hain. Ise fix karna (fast load, chhota form, click-to-call) andhe traffic cut ya scale karne se better hai.
exp.mr: Segment मधील फरक mobile UX समस्या दाखवतो, आणि बहुतांश visitors तेच पाहतात. ते दुरुस्त करणे (जलद load, छोटा form, click-to-call) traffic आंधळेपणाने कमी/वाढवण्यापेक्षा चांगले.

q.en: What is the main weakness of last-click attribution?
q.hi: Last-click attribution ki sabse badi kamzori kya hai?
q.mr: Last-click attribution ची मुख्य कमजोरी काय?

en: It cannot be used for e-commerce sites
It only works with a BigQuery export
It gives too much credit to display ads
It ignores earlier awareness touchpoints
hi: Ise e-commerce sites pe use nahi kar sakte
Ye sirf BigQuery export ke saath chalta hai
Display ads ko bahut zyada credit deta hai
Pehle wale awareness touchpoints ignore karta hai
mr: हे e-commerce sites साठी वापरता येत नाही
हे फक्त BigQuery export सोबत चालते
Display ads ना खूप जास्त credit देते
आधीचे awareness touchpoints दुर्लक्षित करते

exp.en: Last-click gives 100% credit to the final touch (often brand search or direct), so channels that created demand earlier look useless and may get wrongly cut.
exp.hi: Last-click 100% credit final touch ko deta hai (aksar brand search ya direct), isliye jin channels ne pehle demand banayi woh bekaar lagte hain aur galti se cut ho sakte hain.
exp.mr: Last-click 100% credit शेवटच्या touch ला देतो (बहुतेक brand search किंवा direct), त्यामुळे आधी demand निर्माण करणारे channels निरुपयोगी दिसतात आणि चुकून बंद होऊ शकतात.

q.en: A 12-person Pune agency notices its own team visiting the website all day, inflating traffic and skewing engagement. What should it do in GA4?
q.hi: 12 logon ki Pune agency ki team din bhar apni website visit karti hai, jisse traffic aur engagement bigad raha hai. GA4 mein kya karein?
q.mr: 12 जणांच्या पुण्यातील agency ची team दिवसभर स्वतःची वेबसाइट उघडते, त्यामुळे traffic आणि engagement बिघडते. GA4 मध्ये काय करावे?

en: Ask the team to browse only in incognito mode
Define office IPs as internal and activate the filter
Delete last month's data from the property
Lower the engaged-session timer to 5 seconds
hi: Team ko sirf incognito mode mein browse karne bolo
Office IPs ko internal define karke filter activate karo
Property se pichle mahine ka data delete karo
Engaged-session timer 5 seconds kar do
mr: Team ला फक्त incognito mode मध्ये browse करायला सांगा
Office IPs internal म्हणून define करून filter activate करा
Property मधून मागील महिन्याचा data delete करा
Engaged-session timer 5 seconds करा

exp.en: GA4 lets you tag traffic from your IPs as internal and then activate a data filter to exclude it. Incognito doesn't hide visits, and filters only apply going forward.
exp.hi: GA4 mein apne IPs ka traffic internal mark karke data filter activate karke exclude kar sakte ho. Incognito visits nahi chhupata, aur filters sirf aage ke data pe lagte hain.
exp.mr: GA4 मध्ये तुमच्या IPs चा traffic internal म्हणून mark करून data filter activate करून वगळता येतो. Incognito visits लपवत नाही, आणि filters फक्त पुढील data वर लागू होतात.

q.en: An A/B test is 'significant at 95% confidence' (p < 0.05). What does that correctly mean?
q.hi: Ek A/B test '95% confidence pe significant' hai (p < 0.05). Iska sahi matlab kya hai?
q.mr: एक A/B test '95% confidence वर significant' आहे (p < 0.05). याचा योग्य अर्थ काय?

en: There is a 95% chance that variant B is truly better
B will keep this exact lift for 95% of all future users
With no true difference, such a result occurs <5% of the time
95% of the users in the test preferred variant B
hi: 95% chance hai ki variant B better hai
B ka yahi lift 95% future users ke liye rahega
Asli difference na ho to aisa result <5% baar aata
Test ke 95% users ne variant B pasand kiya
mr: Variant B चांगला असण्याची 95% शक्यता आहे
B चा हाच lift पुढील 95% users साठी टिकेल
खरा फरक नसता तर असा result <5% वेळा येतो
Test मधील 95% users नी variant B निवडला

exp.en: A p-value measures how surprising the data would be if there were no real effect. It is not the probability that B is better, and it says nothing about the size of the lift.
exp.hi: P-value batata hai ki agar real effect na ho to data kitna surprising hoga. Ye B ke better hone ki probability nahi hai, aur lift ka size bhi nahi batata.
exp.mr: P-value सांगतो की खरा परिणाम नसता तर data किती आश्चर्यकारक असता. ही B चांगला असण्याची probability नाही, आणि lift किती आहे तेही सांगत नाही.

q.en: A developer runs dataLayer.push({event: 'form_submit'}). Which GTM trigger type should you use to fire a tag on it?
q.hi: Developer dataLayer.push({event: 'form_submit'}) chalata hai. Is pe tag fire karne ke liye kaunsa GTM trigger type use karein?
q.mr: Developer dataLayer.push({event: 'form_submit'}) चालवतो. यावर tag fire करण्यासाठी कोणता GTM trigger type वापरावा?

en: Page View trigger firing on all pages
Custom Event trigger named 'form_submit'
Timer trigger set to fire every 5 seconds
Scroll Depth trigger at 90% vertical
hi: Saare pages pe fire hone wala Page View trigger
'form_submit' naam ka Custom Event trigger
Har 5 seconds pe fire hone wala Timer trigger
90% vertical pe Scroll Depth trigger
mr: सर्व pages वर fire होणारा Page View trigger
'form_submit' नावाचा Custom Event trigger
दर 5 seconds ला fire होणारा Timer trigger
90% vertical वर Scroll Depth trigger

exp.en: A Custom Event trigger listens for the 'event' key pushed to the dataLayer. Matching the exact name 'form_submit' fires your tag only when the developer's push happens.
exp.hi: Custom Event trigger dataLayer mein push hue 'event' key ko sunta hai. Exact naam 'form_submit' match karne se tag tabhi fire hoga jab developer ka push hoga.
exp.mr: Custom Event trigger dataLayer मध्ये push केलेल्या 'event' key कडे लक्ष देतो. नेमके नाव 'form_submit' जुळवल्यास developer चा push झाल्यावरच tag fire होतो.

q.en: A D2C ethnic-wear store sees 80% of checkout drop-offs on the step where shipping charges first appear. Best CRO move to test?
q.hi: Ek D2C ethnic-wear store mein 80% checkout drop-off us step pe hota hai jahan shipping charges pehli baar dikhte hain. Kaunsa CRO move test karein?
q.mr: एका D2C ethnic-wear store मध्ये 80% checkout drop-off त्या step वर होतो जिथे shipping charges पहिल्यांदा दिसतात. कोणता CRO बदल test करावा?

en: Show shipping costs or a free-shipping threshold early
Add more lifestyle photos to the home page
Increase the frequency of retargeting ads
Remove the guest checkout option entirely
hi: Shipping cost ya free-shipping threshold pehle dikhao
Home page pe aur lifestyle photos daalo
Retargeting ads ki frequency badhao
Guest checkout option poori tarah hata do
mr: Shipping खर्च किंवा free-shipping threshold आधीच दाखवा
Home page वर अधिक lifestyle photos टाका
Retargeting ads ची frequency वाढवा
Guest checkout पर्याय पूर्णपणे काढा

exp.en: Unexpected extra costs at checkout are a classic abandonment cause. Showing them upfront or offering a free-shipping threshold targets the exact step where users leave.
exp.hi: Checkout pe achanak extra cost dikhna abandonment ka classic kaaran hai. Pehle dikhana ya free-shipping threshold dena usi step ko target karta hai jahan users chhod rahe hain.
exp.mr: Checkout वर अचानक अतिरिक्त खर्च दिसणे हे abandonment चे classic कारण आहे. ते आधी दाखवणे किंवा free-shipping threshold देणे नेमक्या त्या step ला लक्ष्य करते.

q.en: To track clicks on a home-page banner, the team added utm_source=homebanner to the internal link. What problem does this create?
q.hi: Home-page banner ke clicks track karne ke liye team ne internal link pe utm_source=homebanner laga diya. Isse kya problem hogi?
q.mr: Home-page banner चे clicks track करण्यासाठी team ने internal link ला utm_source=homebanner लावले. यामुळे काय अडचण येईल?

en: None; this is Google's recommended method
The banner will stop showing on mobile phones
GA4 will flag and block the website's tag
It overwrites the visitor's real traffic source
hi: Koi nahi; ye Google ka recommended tareeka hai
Banner mobile phones pe dikhna band ho jaayega
GA4 website ke tag ko flag karke block karega
Visitor ka asli traffic source overwrite ho jaata hai
mr: काही नाही; ही Google ची recommended पद्धत आहे
Banner mobile phones वर दिसणे बंद होईल
GA4 वेबसाइटचा tag flag करून block करेल
Visitor चा खरा traffic source overwrite होतो

exp.en: UTMs are for external campaigns. On internal links they replace the true source (e.g. Google Ads), corrupting attribution. Track internal clicks with a GA4 event and parameters instead.
exp.hi: UTMs external campaigns ke liye hain. Internal links pe ye asli source (jaise Google Ads) replace kar dete hain aur attribution kharab hota hai. Internal clicks GA4 event aur parameters se track karo.
exp.mr: UTMs बाह्य campaigns साठी असतात. Internal links वर ते खरा source (उदा. Google Ads) बदलतात आणि attribution बिघडते. Internal clicks GA4 event आणि parameters ने track करा.

q.en: Your team checks an A/B test every morning and plans to stop it the first day it hits p < 0.05. What's wrong with this?
q.hi: Team har subah A/B test check karti hai aur jis din p < 0.05 aaye usi din rokne ka plan hai. Isme kya galat hai?
q.mr: Team दररोज सकाळी A/B test पाहते आणि ज्या दिवशी p < 0.05 येईल त्या दिवशी थांबवायचे ठरवते. यात काय चूक आहे?

en: Nothing; checking often makes results more accurate
p-values are only valid for weekend traffic
Peeking and stopping early inflates false positives
Every test must run for exactly 7 days
hi: Kuch nahi; baar-baar check karne se accuracy badhti hai
p-values sirf weekend traffic pe valid hain
Peeking karke jaldi rokna false positives badhata hai
Har test exactly 7 din chalna chahiye
mr: काही नाही; वारंवार पाहिल्याने अचूकता वाढते
p-values फक्त weekend traffic साठी वैध आहेत
Peeking करून लवकर थांबवल्याने false positives वाढतात
प्रत्येक test नेमके 7 दिवस चालायला हवा

exp.en: Each peek is another chance for random noise to cross p < 0.05, so the real false-positive rate ends up far above 5%. Pre-set the sample size, or use methods built for continuous monitoring.
exp.hi: Har peek random noise ko p < 0.05 cross karne ka ek aur mauka deta hai, isliye asli false-positive rate 5% se kaafi upar chala jaata hai. Sample size pehle tay karo ya continuous monitoring wale methods use karo.
exp.mr: प्रत्येक peek मुळे random noise ला p < 0.05 ओलांडण्याची आणखी एक संधी मिळते, त्यामुळे खरा false-positive दर 5% पेक्षा खूप वर जातो. Sample size आधी ठरवा किंवा continuous monitoring साठीच्या पद्धती वापरा.

q.en: An ed-tech app's marketing team is rewarded only on 'app installs'. Installs doubled, but paid subscriptions haven't moved. Which KPI change makes most sense?
q.hi: Ek ed-tech app ki marketing team ko sirf 'app installs' pe reward milta hai. Installs double ho gaye, par paid subscriptions wahi hain. Kaunsa KPI change best hai?
q.mr: एका ed-tech app च्या marketing team ला फक्त 'app installs' वर reward मिळते. Installs दुप्पट झाले, पण paid subscriptions तसेच आहेत. कोणता KPI बदल योग्य?

en: Track installs daily instead of monthly
Cost per paying subscriber, plus activation rate
Track only the average app store rating
Track the total push notifications sent
hi: Monthly ke bajaye daily installs track karo
Cost per paying subscriber, saath mein activation rate
Sirf average app store rating track karo
Bheje gaye total push notifications track karo
mr: Monthly ऐवजी daily installs track करा
Cost per paying subscriber, सोबत activation rate
फक्त सरासरी app store rating track करा
पाठवलेले एकूण push notifications track करा

exp.en: Installs can be bought cheaply from low-quality sources. Tying the KPI to paying subscribers (and an activation step) aligns marketing with revenue.
exp.hi: Installs low-quality sources se sasti mil sakti hain. KPI ko paying subscribers (aur activation step) se jodne se marketing revenue ke saath align hoti hai.
exp.mr: Installs कमी दर्जाच्या sources मधून स्वस्तात मिळू शकतात. KPI ला paying subscribers (आणि activation step) शी जोडल्यास marketing revenue शी जुळते.

q.en: In GA4, how do the 'User acquisition' and 'Traffic acquisition' reports differ?
q.hi: GA4 mein 'User acquisition' aur 'Traffic acquisition' reports mein kya farak hai?
q.mr: GA4 मध्ये 'User acquisition' आणि 'Traffic acquisition' reports मध्ये काय फरक आहे?

en: User acquisition: first source per user; Traffic: per session
Both show identical data in different chart colours
User acquisition is paid only; Traffic is organic only
User acquisition is for apps; Traffic is for websites
hi: User acquisition: har user ka pehla source; Traffic: har session ka
Dono same data alag chart colours mein dikhate hain
User acquisition sirf paid; Traffic sirf organic
User acquisition apps ke liye; Traffic websites ke liye
mr: User acquisition: प्रत्येक user चा पहिला source; Traffic: प्रत्येक session चा
दोन्ही एकच data वेगळ्या chart रंगात दाखवतात
User acquisition फक्त paid; Traffic फक्त organic
User acquisition apps साठी; Traffic websites साठी

exp.en: User acquisition uses 'first user' dimensions (how users were originally acquired). Traffic acquisition uses 'session' dimensions, so a returning user's later visits count under their new source.
exp.hi: User acquisition 'first user' dimensions use karta hai (user pehli baar kaise aaya). Traffic acquisition 'session' dimensions use karta hai, isliye returning user ki baad ki visits naye source mein gini jaati hain.
exp.mr: User acquisition 'first user' dimensions वापरतो (user पहिल्यांदा कसा आला). Traffic acquisition 'session' dimensions वापरतो, त्यामुळे returning user च्या नंतरच्या visits नवीन source मध्ये मोजल्या जातात.

q.en: GA4 revenue is 20% higher than the store's backend. You find the purchase event fires again whenever a customer reloads the order-confirmation page. Best fix?
q.hi: GA4 revenue store backend se 20% zyada hai. Pata chala ki customer order-confirmation page reload kare to purchase event dobara fire hota hai. Best fix?
q.mr: GA4 revenue store backend पेक्षा 20% जास्त आहे. Customer order-confirmation page reload करतो तेव्हा purchase event पुन्हा fire होतो असे आढळले. योग्य उपाय?

en: Send a unique transaction_id and fire the tag once per order
Divide GA4 revenue by 1.2 in every single report
Move the purchase tag onto the product page
Fire the purchase event on scroll depth instead
hi: Unique transaction_id bhejo aur tag har order pe ek hi baar fire karo
Har ek report mein GA4 revenue ko 1.2 se divide karo
Purchase tag ko product page pe shift kar do
Purchase event ko scroll depth pe fire karao
mr: Unique transaction_id पाठवा आणि tag प्रत्येक order ला एकदाच fire करा
प्रत्येक report मध्ये GA4 revenue ला 1.2 ने भागा
Purchase tag product page वर हलवा
Purchase event scroll depth वर fire करा

exp.en: A unique transaction_id lets GA4 identify repeat hits of the same order, and firing the tag only once (e.g. a flag set after the first send) stops the inflation at the source. Manual correction factors are unreliable.
exp.hi: Unique transaction_id se GA4 same order ke repeat hits pehchan sakta hai, aur tag ek hi baar fire karna (jaise pehli baar bhejne ke baad flag set karna) inflation ko source pe hi rokta hai. Manual correction factor bharosemand nahi.
exp.mr: Unique transaction_id मुळे GA4 एकाच order चे पुनरावृत्त hits ओळखू शकतो, आणि tag एकदाच fire करणे (उदा. पहिल्यांदा पाठवल्यावर flag लावणे) फुगवटा मुळातच थांबवते. Manual correction factor विश्वसनीय नसतो.

q.en: A skincare D2C brand's CAC is ₹1,200. Each customer brings about ₹200 gross margin per month. Ignoring churn, what is the CAC payback period?
q.hi: Ek skincare D2C brand ka CAC ₹1,200 hai. Har customer se mahine ka lagbhag ₹200 gross margin aata hai. Churn ignore karke CAC payback period kitna hai?
q.mr: एका skincare D2C brand चा CAC ₹1,200 आहे. प्रत्येक ग्राहकाकडून दरमहा सुमारे ₹200 gross margin मिळतो. Churn दुर्लक्षित करून CAC payback period किती?

en: 3 months
6 months
12 months
24 months
hi: 3 months
6 months
12 months
24 months
mr: 3 महिने
6 महिने
12 महिने
24 महिने

exp.en: Payback = CAC ÷ monthly gross margin per customer = ₹1,200 ÷ ₹200 = 6 months. With churn it would take longer, since some customers leave before paying back.
exp.hi: Payback = CAC ÷ monthly gross margin per customer = ₹1,200 ÷ ₹200 = 6 months. Churn ho to zyada time lagega, kyunki kuch customers payback se pehle chale jaate hain.
exp.mr: Payback = CAC ÷ प्रति ग्राहक मासिक gross margin = ₹1,200 ÷ ₹200 = 6 महिने. Churn असल्यास जास्त वेळ लागेल, कारण काही ग्राहक payback आधीच सोडून जातात.

q.en: A redesigned menu lifted clicks 15% in week 1, but the lift shrank to almost zero by week 3, mostly among returning users. Most likely explanation?
q.hi: Naye menu design se week 1 mein clicks 15% badhe, par week 3 tak lift lagbhag zero ho gaya, mostly returning users mein. Sabse likely kaaran?
q.mr: नवीन menu design मुळे week 1 मध्ये clicks 15% वाढले, पण week 3 पर्यंत lift जवळपास शून्य झाला, मुख्यतः returning users मध्ये. सर्वात संभाव्य कारण?

en: The GA4 tag stopped working in week 2
Search engines penalised the new menu
Novelty effect: curiosity clicks that faded
The test sample grew too large to measure
hi: Week 2 mein GA4 tag kaam karna band ho gaya
Search engines ne naye menu ko penalise kiya
Novelty effect: curiosity ke clicks jo fade ho gaye
Test sample measure karne ke liye bahut bada ho gaya
mr: Week 2 मध्ये GA4 tag चालणे बंद झाले
Search engines नी नवीन menu ला penalty दिली
Novelty effect: उत्सुकतेचे clicks जे ओसरले
Test sample मोजण्यासाठी खूप मोठा झाला

exp.en: Returning users often click on anything new out of curiosity, then settle down. Run tests long enough and compare new vs returning users before trusting an early lift.
exp.hi: Returning users aksar kuch naya dikhe to curiosity mein click karte hain, phir settle ho jaate hain. Tests kaafi lambe chalao aur early lift pe bharosa karne se pehle new vs returning users compare karo.
exp.mr: Returning users नवीन काही दिसले की उत्सुकतेने click करतात, मग स्थिर होतात. Tests पुरेसे दिवस चालवा आणि सुरुवातीच्या lift वर विश्वास ठेवण्याआधी new vs returning users तुलना करा.

q.en: In 2023 Google removed first-click, linear, time-decay and position-based models from GA4 and Google Ads. What type of models remain?
q.hi: 2023 mein Google ne GA4 aur Google Ads se first-click, linear, time-decay aur position-based models hata diye. Ab kaunse models bache hain?
q.mr: 2023 मध्ये Google ने GA4 आणि Google Ads मधून first-click, linear, time-decay आणि position-based models काढले. आता कोणते models उरले?

en: Only the first-click model
Only linear and time-decay models
Only view-through based models
Data-driven and last-click models
hi: Sirf first-click model
Sirf linear aur time-decay models
Sirf view-through based models
Data-driven aur last-click models
mr: फक्त first-click model
फक्त linear आणि time-decay models
फक्त view-through आधारित models
Data-driven आणि last-click models

exp.en: After the 2023 change, GA4 offers data-driven attribution plus last-click variants (paid and organic last click, Google paid channels last click). The rule-based multi-touch models were retired.
exp.hi: 2023 ke change ke baad GA4 mein data-driven attribution aur last-click variants (paid and organic last click, Google paid channels last click) hain. Rule-based multi-touch models retire ho gaye.
exp.mr: 2023 च्या बदलानंतर GA4 मध्ये data-driven attribution आणि last-click प्रकार (paid and organic last click, Google paid channels last click) आहेत. Rule-based multi-touch models बंद झाले.

q.en: An A/B test is planned with 80% statistical power. What does that mean?
q.hi: Ek A/B test 80% statistical power ke saath plan hua hai. Iska matlab kya hai?
q.mr: एक A/B test 80% statistical power ने plan केला आहे. याचा अर्थ काय?

en: An 80% chance to detect a true lift of the planned size
80% of all visitors will be shown variant B
The winning variant will convert 80% better
An 80% chance that the result is a false positive
hi: Planned size ka asli lift detect karne ka 80% chance
Saare visitors mein se 80% ko variant B dikhega
Winning variant 80% better convert karega
Result false positive hone ka 80% chance
mr: Planned आकाराचा खरा lift ओळखण्याची 80% शक्यता
सर्व visitors पैकी 80% ना variant B दिसेल
जिंकणारा variant 80% जास्त convert करेल
Result false positive असण्याची 80% शक्यता

exp.en: Power is the probability of detecting a real effect of the planned size. Low power means real winners are often missed (false negatives); it's set with the MDE to size the test.
exp.hi: Power matlab planned size ka real effect detect karne ki probability. Kam power ho to asli winners aksar miss ho jaate hain (false negatives); ise MDE ke saath set karke test ka size tay hota hai.
exp.mr: Power म्हणजे planned आकाराचा खरा परिणाम ओळखण्याची probability. Power कमी असल्यास खरे विजेते अनेकदा सुटतात (false negatives); MDE सोबत हे ठरवून test चा size काढतात.

q.en: Your site has sent a 'course_name' event parameter for 3 months, but you only registered it as a custom dimension in GA4 today. What will standard reports show?
q.hi: Aapki site 3 mahine se 'course_name' event parameter bhej rahi hai, par GA4 mein custom dimension aaj register kiya. Standard reports kya dikhayengi?
q.mr: तुमची site 3 महिन्यांपासून 'course_name' event parameter पाठवते, पण GA4 मध्ये custom dimension आज register केले. Standard reports काय दाखवतील?

en: All 3 months of data, backfilled automatically
Nothing until the property is recreated from scratch
Values only from the time of registration onward
Data only for users who were logged in
hi: Poore 3 mahine ka data, automatically backfill hoke
Property shuru se dobara banane tak kuch nahi
Values sirf registration ke time se aage
Sirf logged-in users ka data
mr: संपूर्ण 3 महिन्यांचा data, आपोआप backfill होऊन
Property सुरुवातीपासून पुन्हा तयार करेपर्यंत काहीच नाही
Values फक्त registration केल्यापासून पुढे
फक्त logged-in users चा data

exp.en: GA4 custom dimensions are not retroactive. Register parameters as soon as you start sending them; the historic values exist only in raw data such as a BigQuery export.
exp.hi: GA4 custom dimensions retroactive nahi hote. Parameters bhejna shuru karte hi register karo; purani values sirf raw data jaise BigQuery export mein milti hain.
exp.mr: GA4 custom dimensions मागील काळासाठी लागू होत नाहीत. Parameters पाठवायला सुरुवात करताच register करा; जुन्या values फक्त BigQuery export सारख्या raw data मध्ये मिळतात.

q.en: A D2C brand ships to Europe. Its cookie banner works, but GA4 and the Meta Pixel fire on page load before the visitor clicks 'Accept'. What should be fixed?
q.hi: Ek D2C brand Europe mein ship karta hai. Cookie banner hai, par visitor ke 'Accept' click karne se pehle hi page load pe GA4 aur Meta Pixel fire ho jaate hain. Kya fix karna chahiye?
q.mr: एक D2C brand Europe मध्ये ship करतो. Cookie banner आहे, पण visitor 'Accept' click करण्याआधीच page load वर GA4 आणि Meta Pixel fire होतात. काय दुरुस्त करावे?

en: Nothing; showing a visible banner is enough
Make tags wait for consent (default: denied)
Move the cookie banner down to the footer
Fire the tags only on mobile devices
hi: Kuch nahi; banner dikhna hi kaafi hai
Tags ko consent ka wait karwao (default: denied)
Cookie banner ko footer mein neeche le jao
Tags sirf mobile devices pe fire karo
mr: काही नाही; banner दिसणे पुरेसे आहे
Tags ना consent ची वाट पाहायला लावा (default: denied)
Cookie banner खाली footer मध्ये हलवा
Tags फक्त mobile devices वर fire करा

exp.en: Under GDPR/ePrivacy rules, non-essential analytics and ad cookies need consent first. A banner that doesn't actually block or adjust tags until consent is given doesn't meet that.
exp.hi: GDPR/ePrivacy rules ke under non-essential analytics aur ad cookies ke liye pehle consent chahiye. Jo banner consent milne tak tags ko block ya adjust nahi karta, woh kaafi nahi hai.
exp.mr: GDPR/ePrivacy नियमांनुसार non-essential analytics आणि ad cookies साठी आधी consent लागते. Consent मिळेपर्यंत tags थांबवत किंवा बदलत नसलेला banner पुरेसा नाही.

q.en: In GA4 attribution settings, what is the default lookback window for key events other than first_visit / first_open?
q.hi: GA4 attribution settings mein first_visit / first_open ke alawa key events ka default lookback window kitna hai?
q.mr: GA4 attribution settings मध्ये first_visit / first_open सोडून इतर key events साठी default lookback window किती?

en: 7 days
30 days
90 days
180 days
hi: 7 days
30 days
90 days
180 days
mr: 7 दिवस
30 दिवस
90 दिवस
180 दिवस

exp.en: GA4 defaults to a 90-day lookback for most key events (options 30/60/90) and 30 days for acquisition events like first_visit (options 7/30). Touchpoints older than that get no credit.
exp.hi: GA4 mein zyada tar key events ka default lookback 90 din hai (options 30/60/90) aur first_visit jaise acquisition events ka 30 din (options 7/30). Isse purane touchpoints ko credit nahi milta.
exp.mr: GA4 मध्ये बहुतेक key events साठी default lookback 90 दिवस (पर्याय 30/60/90) आणि first_visit सारख्या acquisition events साठी 30 दिवस (पर्याय 7/30) असतो. त्याहून जुन्या touchpoints ना credit मिळत नाही.

q.en: Your 50/50 A/B test shows 10,000 users in A but only 8,900 in B. B has a higher conversion rate. What should you do first?
q.hi: Aapke 50/50 A/B test mein A mein 10,000 users aur B mein sirf 8,900. B ka conversion rate zyada hai. Pehle kya karein?
q.mr: तुमच्या 50/50 A/B test मध्ये A मध्ये 10,000 users तर B मध्ये फक्त 8,900. B चा conversion rate जास्त आहे. आधी काय करावे?

en: Declare B the winner, since it converts better
Manually add 1,100 users to variant B
Ignore it, since splits are never exact
Investigate it as a sample ratio mismatch first
hi: B ko winner declare karo, woh better convert karta hai
Variant B mein manually 1,100 users add karo
Ignore karo, split kabhi exact nahi hota
Pehle ise sample ratio mismatch maan ke investigate karo
mr: B जास्त convert करतो म्हणून त्याला winner घोषित करा
Variant B मध्ये manually 1,100 users जोडा
दुर्लक्ष करा, split कधीच नेमका नसतो
आधी याला sample ratio mismatch मानून तपास करा

exp.en: Small random imbalances are normal, but a gap this large on ~19,000 users is extremely unlikely by chance. SRM usually means B lost some users (e.g. slow load, redirect or tag bugs), which biases the result.
exp.hi: Chhota random imbalance normal hai, par ~19,000 users pe itna bada gap chance se lagbhag namumkin hai. SRM ka matlab aksar B ke kuch users kho gaye (slow load, redirect ya tag bug), jisse result biased hota hai.
exp.mr: थोडा random असमतोल सामान्य आहे, पण ~19,000 users वर इतका मोठा फरक योगायोगाने जवळपास अशक्य आहे. SRM म्हणजे बहुतेक B चे काही users गळले (slow load, redirect किंवा tag bug), ज्यामुळे result biased होतो.

q.en: Why might GA4 hide some rows and show a 'thresholding applied' notice in a report with small user counts?
q.hi: Chhote user counts wali report mein GA4 kuch rows kyun chhupata hai aur 'thresholding applied' notice dikhata hai?
q.mr: कमी user counts असलेल्या report मध्ये GA4 काही rows का लपवते आणि 'thresholding applied' notice दाखवते?

en: To stop individual users being identified
Because the free GA4 quota has run out
Because the tag was installed twice on the site
Because data retention is set to only 2 months
hi: Taaki individual users pehchane na jaa sakein
Kyunki free GA4 quota khatam ho gaya
Kyunki site pe tag do baar install hua hai
Kyunki data retention sirf 2 months pe set hai
mr: व्यक्तिगत users ओळखले जाऊ नयेत म्हणून
कारण मोफत GA4 quota संपला
कारण site वर tag दोनदा install झाला
कारण data retention फक्त 2 महिने ठेवले आहे

exp.en: Data thresholds are a privacy safeguard: when counts are small and data like demographics is involved, GA4 withholds rows that could reveal individuals. Wider date ranges often reduce it.
exp.hi: Data thresholds privacy safeguard hain: jab counts chhote hon aur demographics jaisa data involved ho, GA4 woh rows rok leta hai jo individuals reveal kar sakti hain. Bada date range aksar ise kam karta hai.
exp.mr: Data thresholds हे privacy संरक्षण आहे: counts कमी असताना आणि demographics सारखा data असताना, GA4 व्यक्ती उघड करू शकणाऱ्या rows रोखते. मोठा date range घेतल्यास हे अनेकदा कमी होते.

q.en: A GA4 standard report on page_location shows a huge '(other)' row. What is the most likely cause?
q.hi: page_location wali GA4 standard report mein bahut bada '(other)' row dikh raha hai. Sabse likely kaaran?
q.mr: page_location वरील GA4 standard report मध्ये खूप मोठी '(other)' row दिसते. सर्वात संभाव्य कारण?

en: Many visitors are using ad blockers
Too many unique values exceeded row limits
The property's currency is set incorrectly
Consent Mode is switched off on the site
hi: Bahut visitors ad blockers use kar rahe hain
Bahut zyada unique values ne row limits cross ki
Property ki currency galat set hai
Site pe Consent Mode off hai
mr: अनेक visitors ad blockers वापरत आहेत
खूप जास्त unique values मुळे row मर्यादा ओलांडली
Property ची currency चुकीची set आहे
Site वर Consent Mode बंद आहे

exp.en: When a dimension has too many unique values, GA4 groups the long tail into '(other)'. Cleaning URLs (dropping session IDs/query strings), Explorations or BigQuery help.
exp.hi: Jab kisi dimension mein bahut zyada unique values hon, GA4 long tail ko '(other)' mein group kar deta hai. URLs saaf karna (session IDs/query strings hatana), Explorations ya BigQuery madad karte hain.
exp.mr: एखाद्या dimension मध्ये खूप जास्त unique values असल्यास GA4 long tail ला '(other)' मध्ये गटबद्ध करते. URLs स्वच्छ करणे (session IDs/query strings काढणे), Explorations किंवा BigQuery उपयोगी पडतात.

q.en: In Looker Studio, a scorecard averages each day's conversion rate. Day 1: 1 sale from 10 visits (10%). Day 2: 10 sales from 1,000 visits (1%). It shows 5.5%. What's the right approach?
q.hi: Looker Studio scorecard har din ke conversion rate ka average leta hai. Day 1: 10 visits se 1 sale (10%). Day 2: 1,000 visits se 10 sales (1%). Ye 5.5% dikhata hai. Sahi approach?
q.mr: Looker Studio scorecard प्रत्येक दिवसाच्या conversion rate चा average घेतो. Day 1: 10 visits मधून 1 sale (10%). Day 2: 1,000 visits मधून 10 sales (1%). तो 5.5% दाखवतो. योग्य पद्धत?

en: 5.5% is correct; averaging daily rates is standard
Use the median of the daily rates instead
Total sales ÷ total visits: 11 ÷ 1,010 ≈ 1.1%
Show only the best day's rate as the headline
hi: 5.5% sahi hai; daily rates ka average standard hai
Daily rates ka median lo
Total sales ÷ total visits: 11 ÷ 1,010 ≈ 1.1%
Headline mein sirf best din ka rate dikhao
mr: 5.5% बरोबर; daily rates चा average घेणे standard आहे
Daily rates चा median घ्या
एकूण sales ÷ एकूण visits: 11 ÷ 1,010 ≈ 1.1%
Headline मध्ये फक्त सर्वोत्तम दिवसाचा rate दाखवा

exp.en: Averaging ratios gives a tiny day the same weight as a big day. Build the metric as SUM(conversions) / SUM(sessions) so it's weighted by volume.
exp.hi: Ratios ka average lene se chhote din ko bade din jitna weight milta hai. Metric ko SUM(conversions) / SUM(sessions) banao taaki volume ke hisaab se weight ho.
exp.mr: Ratios चा average घेतल्याने लहान दिवसाला मोठ्या दिवसाइतकेच वजन मिळते. Metric SUM(conversions) / SUM(sessions) असा बनवा म्हणजे volume नुसार वजन मिळते.

q.en: Google Ads shows 120 conversions for a month, but GA4 attributes only 85 to Google Ads. What is the most likely reason?
q.hi: Google Ads ek mahine mein 120 conversions dikhata hai, par GA4 sirf 85 Google Ads ko attribute karta hai. Sabse likely kaaran?
q.mr: Google Ads एका महिन्यात 120 conversions दाखवते, पण GA4 फक्त 85 Google Ads ला attribute करते. सर्वात संभाव्य कारण?

en: GA4 deletes paid conversions older than 7 days
Google Ads counts every page view as a conversion
One of the two tools must definitely be broken
They use different attribution scope and dating
hi: GA4 7 din se purane paid conversions delete karta hai
Google Ads har page view ko conversion ginta hai
Dono mein se ek tool pakka kharab hai
Dono ka attribution scope aur date basis alag hai
mr: GA4 7 दिवसांपेक्षा जुने paid conversions delete करते
Google Ads प्रत्येक page view ला conversion मोजते
दोन्हीपैकी एक tool नक्की बिघडले आहे
दोघांचा attribution scope आणि date आधार वेगळा आहे

exp.en: Ad platforms mostly see only their own touchpoints and report by click date, while GA4 compares all channels and reports by conversion date. Some gap is normal; investigate only large or sudden changes.
exp.hi: Ad platforms zyada tar sirf apne touchpoints dekhte hain aur click date se report karte hain, jabki GA4 saare channels compare karke conversion date se report karta hai. Thoda gap normal hai; sirf bade ya achanak changes investigate karo.
exp.mr: Ad platforms बहुतेक फक्त स्वतःचे touchpoints पाहतात आणि click date नुसार report करतात, तर GA4 सर्व channels तुलना करून conversion date नुसार report करते. थोडा फरक सामान्य आहे; फक्त मोठे किंवा अचानक बदल तपासा.

q.en: Google Ads 'enhanced conversions' send first-party data like email addresses. How is that data sent?
q.hi: Google Ads 'enhanced conversions' email jaisa first-party data bhejte hain. Ye data kaise bheja jaata hai?
q.mr: Google Ads 'enhanced conversions' email सारखा first-party data पाठवतात. हा data कसा पाठवला जातो?

en: Normalised and hashed with SHA-256 before matching
As plain text inside the URL
Encrypted with the customer's own password
Printed and uploaded as a PDF each month
hi: Normalise karke SHA-256 se hash karke, phir matching
URL ke andar plain text mein
Customer ke apne password se encrypt karke
Har mahine print karke PDF upload karke
mr: Normalise करून SHA-256 ने hash करून, मग matching
URL मध्ये plain text म्हणून
ग्राहकाच्या स्वतःच्या password ने encrypt करून
दर महिन्याला print करून PDF upload करून

exp.en: Enhanced conversions normalise (e.g. lowercase, trim) and hash customer data with SHA-256, then match it to signed-in Google accounts to recover conversions that cookies miss.
exp.hi: Enhanced conversions customer data ko normalise (lowercase, trim) karke SHA-256 se hash karte hain, phir signed-in Google accounts se match karke woh conversions recover karte hain jo cookies miss kar deti hain.
exp.mr: Enhanced conversions ग्राहकाचा data normalise (lowercase, trim) करून SHA-256 ने hash करतात, मग signed-in Google accounts शी जुळवून cookies मधून सुटलेले conversions परत मिळवतात.

q.en: Your A/B testing script assigns a variant per session, so a returning shopper sees version A on Monday and B on Wednesday. What is the main problem?
q.hi: Aapki A/B testing script har session pe variant assign karti hai, to returning shopper Monday ko version A aur Wednesday ko B dekhta hai. Main problem kya hai?
q.mr: तुमची A/B testing script प्रत्येक session ला variant देते, त्यामुळे returning shopper Monday ला version A आणि Wednesday ला B पाहतो. मुख्य समस्या काय?

en: Session-based tests always need double the traffic
Users see both variants; assign per user instead
It breaks GA4's 30-minute session timeout
No problem, as long as the split stays 50/50
hi: Session-based tests ko hamesha double traffic chahiye
Users dono variants dekhte hain; per user assign karo
Isse GA4 ka 30-minute session timeout toot jaata hai
Koi problem nahi, jab tak split 50/50 hai
mr: Session-based tests ना नेहमी दुप्पट traffic लागतो
Users दोन्ही variants पाहतात; प्रति user assign करा
यामुळे GA4 चा 30-minute session timeout तुटतो
Split 50/50 असेपर्यंत काही समस्या नाही

exp.en: Purchases often happen across visits. If the same person sees both versions, you can't tell which one drove the sale, and the inconsistent experience itself changes behaviour.
exp.hi: Purchases aksar kai visits ke baad hoti hain. Agar same insaan dono versions dekhe to pata nahi chalega sale kisne karwayi, aur inconsistent experience khud behaviour badal deta hai.
exp.mr: खरेदी अनेकदा अनेक visits नंतर होते. एकाच व्यक्तीने दोन्ही versions पाहिल्यास sale कोणामुळे झाली ते कळत नाही, आणि विसंगत अनुभवच वागणूक बदलतो.

q.en: Your boss says: 'Let's move to server-side GTM so we can still track users who reject cookies.' Best response?
q.hi: Boss bolta hai: 'Server-side GTM pe chalte hain taaki cookies reject karne wale users ko bhi track kar sakein.' Best response?
q.mr: Boss म्हणतात: 'Server-side GTM वर जाऊ म्हणजे cookies नाकारणाऱ्या users ना पण track करता येईल.' योग्य उत्तर?

en: Agree; server-side requests fall outside privacy laws
Agree, but only for users outside India
It helps data control, but consent still applies
Refuse; server-side tagging is illegal in India
hi: Haan; server-side requests privacy laws ke bahar hain
Haan, par sirf India ke bahar ke users ke liye
Isse data control milta hai, par consent phir bhi laagu
Mana karo; server-side tagging India mein illegal hai
mr: हो; server-side requests privacy कायद्यांच्या बाहेर आहेत
हो, पण फक्त भारताबाहेरील users साठी
यामुळे data नियंत्रण मिळते, पण consent तरीही लागू
नकार द्या; server-side tagging भारतात बेकायदेशीर आहे

exp.en: Server-side GTM is legal and useful (less client-side code, data control, first-party context), but it is not a consent loophole: a user's refusal still applies to what you collect.
exp.hi: Server-side GTM legal aur useful hai (kam client-side code, data control, first-party context), par ye consent ka loophole nahi hai: user ka refusal aapke collect kiye data pe phir bhi laagu hota hai.
exp.mr: Server-side GTM कायदेशीर आणि उपयोगी आहे (कमी client-side code, data नियंत्रण, first-party संदर्भ), पण ते consent टाळण्याचा मार्ग नाही: user चा नकार तुम्ही गोळा करता त्या data ला लागू राहतोच.

q.en: GTM stopped receiving later dataLayer events. You find the developer wrote dataLayer = [{pageType: 'product'}] in code placed after the GTM snippet. What's the fix?
q.hi: GTM ko baad wale dataLayer events milna band ho gaye. Pata chala developer ne GTM snippet ke baad wale code mein dataLayer = [{pageType: 'product'}] likha hai. Fix kya hai?
q.mr: GTM ला नंतरचे dataLayer events मिळणे बंद झाले. Developer ने GTM snippet नंतरच्या code मध्ये dataLayer = [{pageType: 'product'}] लिहिल्याचे आढळले. उपाय काय?

en: Rename the variable to dataLayer2 everywhere
Add a second GTM container to the page
Move the GTM snippet into the page footer
Don't reassign it; initialise safely and push()
hi: Har jagah variable ka naam dataLayer2 kar do
Page pe doosra GTM container add karo
GTM snippet ko page footer mein daal do
Reassign mat karo; safely initialise karke push() karo
mr: सगळीकडे variable चे नाव dataLayer2 करा
Page वर दुसरा GTM container जोडा
GTM snippet page footer मध्ये हलवा
Reassign करू नका; सुरक्षित initialise करून push() करा

exp.en: GTM listens to the original dataLayer array. Reassigning it with '=' replaces that array, so GTM no longer sees new pushes. Always initialise safely and use push().
exp.hi: GTM original dataLayer array ko sunta hai. '=' se reassign karne pe woh array replace ho jaata hai, aur GTM naye pushes nahi dekh paata. Hamesha safely initialise karo aur push() use karo.
exp.mr: GTM मूळ dataLayer array कडे लक्ष देतो. '=' ने reassign केल्यास तो array बदलतो, आणि GTM ला नवीन pushes दिसत नाहीत. नेहमी सुरक्षितपणे initialise करा आणि push() वापरा.

q.en: You compare 20 metrics in an A/B test where the change truly has no effect, each at p < 0.05. Roughly how many 'significant' results should you expect by chance?
q.hi: Ek A/B test jisme change ka asal mein koi effect nahi, usme 20 metrics compare karte ho, har ek p < 0.05 pe. Chance se lagbhag kitne 'significant' results expect karoge?
q.mr: ज्या A/B test मधील बदलाचा खरोखर काहीच परिणाम नाही, त्यात 20 metrics p < 0.05 वर तुलना करता. योगायोगाने साधारण किती 'significant' results अपेक्षित?

en: About 1
Zero
About 5
About 10
hi: Lagbhag 1
Zero
Lagbhag 5
Lagbhag 10
mr: सुमारे 1
शून्य
सुमारे 5

exp.en: With a 5% false-positive rate per test, 20 × 0.05 = 1 expected false 'win'. Pick one primary metric in advance, or correct for multiple comparisons.
exp.hi: Har test pe 5% false-positive rate ho to 20 × 0.05 = 1 false 'win' expected hai. Ek primary metric pehle se chuno, ya multiple comparisons ke liye correction karo.
exp.mr: प्रत्येक test ला 5% false-positive दर असल्यास 20 × 0.05 = 1 खोटा 'win' अपेक्षित आहे. एक primary metric आधीच निवडा, किंवा multiple comparisons साठी correction करा.

q.en: Data shows customers who use the 'wishlist' feature repurchase 2x more. The CEO wants a pop-up forcing every user to add a wishlist item. Your advice?
q.hi: Data dikhata hai ki 'wishlist' use karne wale customers 2x zyada repurchase karte hain. CEO har user pe wishlist item add karwane wala pop-up chahta hai. Aapki salah?
q.mr: Data नुसार 'wishlist' वापरणारे ग्राहक 2 पट जास्त पुन्हा खरेदी करतात. CEO ला प्रत्येक user ला wishlist item जोडायला लावणारा pop-up हवा आहे. तुमचा सल्ला?

en: Launch it now, since the data is clear
It may be correlation; A/B test the prompt first
Remove the wishlist feature altogether
Show the pop-up only to past repeat buyers
hi: Abhi launch karo, data clear hai
Ye correlation ho sakta hai; pehle prompt ka A/B test karo
Wishlist feature hi poori tarah hata do
Pop-up sirf purane repeat buyers ko dikhao
mr: आत्ताच launch करा, data स्पष्ट आहे
हे correlation असू शकते; आधी prompt चा A/B test करा
Wishlist feature पूर्णपणे काढून टाका
Pop-up फक्त जुन्या repeat buyers ना दाखवा

exp.en: Loyal users naturally use more features, so the wishlist may be a symptom, not the cause. A randomised test shows whether prompting it actually lifts repurchase — and whether the pop-up annoys people.
exp.hi: Loyal users naturally zyada features use karte hain, isliye wishlist cause nahi, symptom ho sakta hai. Randomised test batayega ki prompt karne se sach mein repurchase badhta hai ya nahi — aur pop-up log irritate to nahi karta.
exp.mr: निष्ठावान users स्वाभाविकपणे जास्त features वापरतात, त्यामुळे wishlist हे कारण नसून लक्षण असू शकते. Randomised test दाखवेल की prompt केल्याने खरोखर repurchase वाढते का — आणि pop-up त्रासदायक ठरतो का.

q.en: A Looker Studio dashboard connected live to GA4 is shared with 40 sales staff and throws 'quota exceeded' errors every Monday morning. Best fix?
q.hi: GA4 se live connected Looker Studio dashboard 40 sales staff ke saath share hai aur har Monday subah 'quota exceeded' errors aate hain. Best fix?
q.mr: GA4 शी live जोडलेला Looker Studio dashboard 40 sales staff सोबत share आहे आणि दर Monday सकाळी 'quota exceeded' errors येतात. योग्य उपाय?

en: Cut live GA4 calls: use Extract Data or BigQuery
Make a separate dashboard copy for each person
Increase GA4 data retention to 14 months
Add more charts so data loads in parallel
hi: Live GA4 calls kam karo: Extract Data ya BigQuery use karo
Har insaan ke liye dashboard ki alag copy banao
GA4 data retention 14 months kar do
Zyada charts daalo taaki data parallel load ho
mr: Live GA4 calls कमी करा: Extract Data किंवा BigQuery वापरा
प्रत्येकासाठी dashboard ची वेगळी copy बनवा
GA4 data retention 14 महिने करा
जास्त charts टाका म्हणजे data parallel load होईल

exp.en: Every chart view queries the GA4 Data API, which has per-property quotas. Extracted or warehoused data serves many viewers without hitting GA4 each time; more charts or copies make it worse.
exp.hi: Har chart view GA4 Data API ko query karta hai, jiske per-property quotas hain. Extracted ya warehouse data bahut viewers ko har baar GA4 hit kiye bina serve karta hai; zyada charts ya copies problem badhati hain.
exp.mr: प्रत्येक chart view GA4 Data API ला query करतो, ज्याला per-property quotas असतात. Extracted किंवा warehouse data प्रत्येक वेळी GA4 ला न विचारता अनेक viewers ना दाखवता येतो; जास्त charts किंवा copies समस्या वाढवतात.

q.en: A coaching institute's Google Ads bid on form fills, but most leads never enrol after the counselling call. Enrolments are recorded in the CRM. Best way to improve lead quality?
q.hi: Ek coaching institute ke Google Ads form fills pe bid karte hain, par zyada tar leads counselling call ke baad enrol nahi karte. Enrolments CRM mein record hote hain. Lead quality improve karne ka best tareeka?
q.mr: एका coaching institute च्या Google Ads form fills वर bid करतात, पण बहुतेक leads counselling call नंतर enrol होत नाहीत. Enrolments CRM मध्ये नोंदवले जातात. Lead quality सुधारण्याचा उत्तम मार्ग?

en: Make the form longer until fewer leads come in
Switch the bidding strategy to Maximise Clicks
Raise the budget so more good leads slip through
Import CRM enrolments as offline conversions via GCLID
hi: Form itna lamba karo ki leads kam aayein
Bidding strategy ko Maximise Clicks pe switch karo
Budget badhao taaki zyada achhe leads aa jaayein
GCLID ke through CRM enrolments offline conversions ki tarah import karo
mr: Leads कमी येईपर्यंत form लांब करा
Bidding strategy Maximise Clicks वर बदला
Budget वाढवा म्हणजे जास्त चांगले leads येतील
GCLID द्वारे CRM enrolments offline conversions म्हणून import करा

exp.en: Importing real enrolments (matched via GCLID) teaches Smart Bidding which clicks lead to revenue, instead of rewarding cheap junk form fills. Maximise clicks ignores lead quality entirely.
exp.hi: Asli enrolments (GCLID se match karke) import karne se Smart Bidding seekhta hai kaunse clicks revenue laate hain, sasti junk form fills ko reward karne ke bajaye. Maximise clicks lead quality ko bilkul ignore karta hai.
exp.mr: खरे enrolments (GCLID ने जुळवून) import केल्याने Smart Bidding ला कोणते clicks revenue आणतात ते कळते, स्वस्त junk form fills ना बक्षीस देण्याऐवजी. Maximise clicks lead quality पूर्ण दुर्लक्षित करतो.

q.en: A test ran 50/50 for 5 days, then you switched to 90% B / 10% A when a Diwali sale started. Pooled, B converts far better. What's the right conclusion?
q.hi: Test 5 din 50/50 chala, phir Diwali sale shuru hote hi 90% B / 10% A kar diya. Pooled data mein B kaafi better convert karta hai. Sahi conclusion?
q.mr: Test 5 दिवस 50/50 चालला, मग Diwali sale सुरू होताच 90% B / 10% A केले. एकत्रित data मध्ये B खूप चांगले convert करते. योग्य निष्कर्ष?

en: B clearly wins, so ship it right away
A wins because it had fewer users overall
Confounded by the sale; compare within periods or rerun
It's valid as long as the total sample is large
hi: B saaf jeeta, turant ship karo
A jeeta kyunki overall uske users kam the
Sale se confounded hai; periods ke andar compare karo ya rerun
Total sample bada ho to test valid hai
mr: B स्पष्ट जिंकला, लगेच ship करा
A जिंकला कारण एकूण त्याचे users कमी होते
Sale मुळे गोंधळलेले; कालावधीनुसार तुलना करा किंवा पुन्हा चालवा
एकूण sample मोठा असल्यास test वैध आहे

exp.en: Changing allocation mid-test while conversion rates shift (sale days) creates a Simpson's-paradox-type bias: B looks better just because it got more high-converting days.
exp.hi: Test ke beech allocation badalna jab conversion rates bhi badal rahe hon (sale days), Simpson's paradox jaisa bias paida karta hai: B sirf isliye better lagta hai kyunki use zyada high-converting din mile.
exp.mr: Conversion rates बदलत असताना (sale दिवस) test मध्येच allocation बदलल्यास Simpson's paradox सारखा bias येतो: B फक्त जास्त high-converting दिवस मिळाल्यामुळे चांगला दिसतो.

q.en: Brand search ads show ₹10 lakh revenue at 20x ROAS. The CFO asks how much of it is truly incremental. Best way to find out?
q.hi: Brand search ads ₹10 lakh revenue 20x ROAS pe dikhate hain. CFO poochta hai isme sach mein incremental kitna hai. Pata karne ka best tareeka?
q.mr: Brand search ads ₹10 lakh revenue 20x ROAS वर दाखवतात. CFO विचारतात यातील खरोखर incremental किती. शोधण्याचा उत्तम मार्ग?

en: Trust the 20x ROAS; the platform tracks it precisely
Run a geo holdout pausing brand ads in some regions
Switch the whole account to a first-click model
Double the brand bid and see if ROAS still holds
hi: 20x ROAS pe bharosa karo; platform exact track karta hai
Kuch regions mein brand ads pause karke geo holdout chalao
Poore account ko first-click model pe switch karo
Brand bid double karke dekho ROAS tikta hai ya nahi
mr: 20x ROAS वर विश्वास ठेवा; platform अचूक track करते
काही regions मध्ये brand ads थांबवून geo holdout चालवा
संपूर्ण account first-click model वर बदला
Brand bid दुप्पट करून ROAS टिकतो का ते पाहा

exp.en: People searching your brand often would have clicked your organic listing anyway, so attributed ROAS overstates value. Only a controlled holdout reveals the true incremental share; changing attribution models just reshuffles credit.
exp.hi: Brand search karne wale log aksar waise bhi aapki organic listing pe click kar dete, isliye attributed ROAS value ko badha chadha ke dikhata hai. Sirf controlled holdout asli incremental share batata hai; attribution model badalna sirf credit idhar-udhar karta hai.
exp.mr: Brand search करणारे लोक बहुतेक वेळा तसेही तुमच्या organic listing वर click केले असते, त्यामुळे attributed ROAS मूल्य फुगवून दाखवतो. फक्त controlled holdout खरा incremental हिस्सा दाखवतो; attribution model बदलल्याने फक्त credit इकडे-तिकडे होते.

q.en: A subscription snack box is growing fast and total active subscribers keep rising. But the cohort table shows month-3 retention for each new monthly cohort falling from 30% to 18%. What does this signal?
q.hi: Ek subscription snack box tezi se grow kar raha hai aur total active subscribers badh rahe hain. Par cohort table mein har naye monthly cohort ka month-3 retention 30% se 18% gir raha hai. Ye kya signal hai?
q.mr: एक subscription snack box वेगाने वाढत आहे आणि एकूण active subscribers वाढत आहेत. पण cohort table मध्ये प्रत्येक नवीन monthly cohort चे month-3 retention 30% वरून 18% पर्यंत घसरत आहे. याचा अर्थ काय?

en: Nothing, because total subscribers are still rising
The cohort table must be wrong, as totals disagree
Retention always falls with growth, so ignore it
Growth hides falling customer quality; find the cause
hi: Kuch nahi, kyunki total subscribers abhi bhi badh rahe hain
Cohort table galat hoga, kyunki totals match nahi karte
Growth ke saath retention hamesha girta hai, ignore karo
Growth girti customer quality chhupa rahi hai; kaaran dhoondo
mr: काही नाही, कारण एकूण subscribers अजूनही वाढत आहेत
Cohort table चुकीचे असावे, कारण totals जुळत नाहीत
वाढीसोबत retention नेहमी घटते, दुर्लक्ष करा
वाढ घसरती customer quality झाकते आहे; कारण शोधा

exp.en: Aggregate totals can rise on heavy acquisition even while each new cohort retains worse — often from discount-led or low-intent channels. Cohorts reveal it early, before growth slows and CAC payback breaks.
