exp.hi: Heavy acquisition se aggregate totals badh sakte hain jabki har naya cohort kam retain kar raha ho — aksar discount-led ya low-intent channels ki wajah se. Cohorts ise jaldi dikhate hain, growth slow hone aur CAC payback bigadne se pehle.
exp.mr: भरपूर acquisition मुळे एकूण आकडे वाढू शकतात तरी प्रत्येक नवीन cohort कमी टिकतो — बहुतेक discount-led किंवा low-intent channels मुळे. Cohorts हे लवकर दाखवतात, वाढ मंदावण्याआधी आणि CAC payback बिघडण्याआधी.

q.en: A small Kolhapur clinic gets about 800 website visits a month at a 2% enquiry rate. The owner wants to A/B test two button colours. Your best advice?
q.hi: Kolhapur ke ek chhote clinic ki website pe mahine mein lagbhag 800 visits aate hain, 2% enquiry rate ke saath. Owner do button colours ka A/B test karna chahta hai. Best salah?
q.mr: कोल्हापूरच्या एका छोट्या clinic च्या वेबसाइटवर दरमहा सुमारे 800 visits येतात, 2% enquiry rate सह. Owner ला दोन button रंगांचा A/B test करायचा आहे. उत्तम सल्ला?

en: Too little traffic; make bold changes based on research
Run the test for 3 days and pick whichever leads
Test 10 button colours at once to learn faster
Stop measuring enquiries and track page views instead
hi: Traffic kam hai; research ke basis pe bold changes karo
3 din test chalao aur jo aage ho use chuno
Jaldi seekhne ke liye ek saath 10 button colours test karo
Enquiries chhodo aur page views track karo
mr: Traffic कमी आहे; संशोधनावर आधारित ठळक बदल करा
3 दिवस test चालवा आणि जो पुढे असेल तो निवडा
लवकर शिकण्यासाठी एकाच वेळी 10 button रंग test करा
Enquiries सोडून page views track करा

exp.en: At ~16 enquiries a month, a colour tweak would need many months to reach significance. Low-traffic sites gain more from big, evidence-led changes; more variants only split traffic further.
exp.hi: Mahine ke ~16 enquiries pe colour tweak ko significance tak pahunchne mein kai mahine lagenge. Low-traffic sites ko bade, evidence-based changes se zyada fayda hota hai; zyada variants traffic ko aur baant dete hain.
exp.mr: दरमहा ~16 enquiries वर रंगबदलाला significance गाठायला अनेक महिने लागतील. कमी traffic sites ना मोठ्या, पुराव्यावर आधारित बदलांचा जास्त फायदा होतो; जास्त variants traffic आणखी विभागतात.

q.en: A Maharashtra FMCG brand wants to measure YouTube ads' true incremental sales (online + retail). Which design is most reliable?
q.hi: Maharashtra ka ek FMCG brand YouTube ads ki asli incremental sales (online + retail) measure karna chahta hai. Sabse reliable design kaunsa hai?
q.mr: महाराष्ट्रातील एक FMCG brand YouTube ads ची खरी incremental sales (online + retail) मोजू इच्छितो. सर्वात विश्वसनीय design कोणता?

en: Run ads in Pune but not Mumbai for a week, then compare
Compare statewide sales before vs after launch in Diwali
Matched test vs control city groups over several weeks
Add up YouTube view-through conversions for the period
hi: Ek hafte Pune mein ads, Mumbai mein nahi, phir compare karo
Diwali mein launch se pehle vs baad statewide sales compare karo
Kai hafton tak matched test vs control city groups
Us period ke YouTube view-through conversions jodo
mr: एक आठवडा Pune मध्ये ads, Mumbai मध्ये नाही, मग तुलना करा
Diwali मध्ये launch आधी vs नंतर राज्यभरातील sales तुलना करा
अनेक आठवडे जुळवलेले test vs control शहर गट
त्या कालावधीतील YouTube view-through conversions बेरीज करा

exp.en: A matched geo experiment captures offline sales and controls for seasonality. One mismatched city pair or a before/after comparison during Diwali is confounded; view-through counts aren't causal.
exp.hi: Matched geo experiment offline sales bhi pakadta hai aur seasonality ko control karta hai. Ek mismatched city pair ya Diwali ke dauran before/after comparison confounded hai; view-through counts causal nahi hote.
exp.mr: जुळवलेला geo experiment offline sales ही पकडतो आणि seasonality नियंत्रित करतो. एक न जुळणारी शहर जोडी किंवा Diwali दरम्यान before/after तुलना गोंधळलेली असते; view-through counts causal नसतात.

q.en: An exit-intent pop-up offering 40% off lifted conversion rate by 12% in a clean A/B test. Before rolling it out, what should decide the call?
q.hi: 40% off wala exit-intent pop-up ek clean A/B test mein conversion rate 12% badha diya. Rollout se pehle faisla kis base pe hona chahiye?
q.mr: 40% सूट देणाऱ्या exit-intent pop-up ने एका स्वच्छ A/B test मध्ये conversion rate 12% वाढवला. Rollout आधी निर्णय कशावर आधारित हवा?

en: The 12% conversion lift alone, since the test was clean
Profit per visitor plus guardrails like returns
How many visitors saw the pop-up in total
Whether major competitors also use pop-ups
hi: Sirf 12% conversion lift, kyunki test clean tha
Profit per visitor aur returns jaise guardrails
Total kitne visitors ne pop-up dekha
Bade competitors bhi pop-ups use karte hain ya nahi
mr: फक्त 12% conversion lift, कारण test स्वच्छ होता
Profit per visitor आणि returns सारखे guardrails
एकूण किती visitors नी pop-up पाहिला
मोठे competitors ही pop-ups वापरतात का

exp.en: A deep discount can raise conversions while cutting profit, training customers to wait for offers or raising returns. Judge on profit per visitor with guardrails, not conversion rate alone.
exp.hi: Bada discount conversions badha sakta hai par profit ghata sakta hai, customers ko offers ka wait karna sikha sakta hai ya returns badha sakta hai. Faisla profit per visitor aur guardrails pe karo, sirf conversion rate pe nahi.
exp.mr: मोठी सूट conversions वाढवू शकते पण नफा कमी करू शकते, ग्राहकांना offers ची वाट पाहायला शिकवू शकते किंवा returns वाढवू शकते. निर्णय profit per visitor आणि guardrails वर घ्या, फक्त conversion rate वर नाही.

q.en: A D2C brand spends ₹50 lakh/month across Google, Meta, YouTube and influencers, and each platform's attribution disagrees. What's the most robust measurement strategy?
q.hi: Ek D2C brand Google, Meta, YouTube aur influencers pe ₹50 lakh/month kharch karta hai, aur har platform ka attribution alag kehta hai. Sabse robust measurement strategy kya hai?
q.mr: एक D2C brand Google, Meta, YouTube आणि influencers वर दरमहा ₹50 लाख खर्च करतो, आणि प्रत्येक platform चे attribution वेगळे सांगते. सर्वात मजबूत measurement strategy कोणती?

en: Trust whichever platform reports the highest ROAS
Add up all platform-reported conversions for a total
Use only GA4 last-click for every budget decision
Triangulate MMM, lift tests and attribution together
hi: Jo platform sabse zyada ROAS dikhaye uspe bharosa karo
Saare platforms ke reported conversions jod ke total nikalo
Har budget decision ke liye sirf GA4 last-click use karo
MMM, lift tests aur attribution ko saath mein triangulate karo
mr: सर्वाधिक ROAS दाखवणाऱ्या platform वर विश्वास ठेवा
सर्व platforms चे reported conversions बेरीज करून एकूण काढा
प्रत्येक budget निर्णयासाठी फक्त GA4 last-click वापरा
MMM, lift tests आणि attribution एकत्र triangulate करा

exp.en: Each method has blind spots: platforms double-count, last-click undervalues upper funnel, MMM is slow and coarse. Using lift tests to calibrate MMM and attribution gives a far more reliable picture.
exp.hi: Har method ke blind spots hain: platforms double-count karte hain, last-click upper funnel ko kam aankta hai, MMM slow aur coarse hai. Lift tests se MMM aur attribution ko calibrate karne se kahin zyada reliable picture milti hai.
exp.mr: प्रत्येक पद्धतीत उणिवा आहेत: platforms दुहेरी मोजणी करतात, last-click upper funnel चे मूल्य कमी दाखवतो, MMM संथ आणि ढोबळ आहे. Lift tests ने MMM आणि attribution calibrate केल्यास खूप विश्वसनीय चित्र मिळते.
